subject.why: The silver hand bell is immediately recognizable with its flared rim, clapper, wooden handle, and charming black bow tie.

category.why: Follows Category 1 perfectly: the bell floats tilted in the air with no ground or surface, set against a radial gradient background with a ring of keyhole motifs.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The object is centrally framed with solid, chunky proportions and clear margins all around.

colour.why: The background uses a rich, warm, saturated red gradient as planned, and the silver and wood bell contrasts distinctly against it.

detail.why: Surfaces are clean and smooth without distracting micro-textures, scratches, or clutter.

style.why: The 3D rendering matches the game's chunky, tactile aesthetic with smooth volumes, soft highlights, and well-defined materials.

bg_colour.why: background is red (100% of the background); planned red
